text: She rose slowly from her chair. <break time="0.8s" /> And came close to him. <break time="0.8s" /> So close that he could see. <break time="0.8s" /> The light in her eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And she stood there waiting. <break time="0.8s" /> As though she still expected something from him. <break time="0.8s" /> Marcher, however. <break time="0.8s" /> Only gazed at her in wonder. <break time="0.8s" /> Understanding nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And the moment. <break time="0.8s" /> For which she had perhaps been waiting all those years. <break time="0.8s" /> Passed without a single word from him. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly a spasm of pain crossed her face. <break time="0.8s" /> Her maid hurried in to help her away. <break time="0.8s" /> And before he could grasp. <break time="0.8s" /> What had happened. <break time="0.8s" /> Marcher found himself standing alone in the room. <break time="0.8s" /> When he was allowed to see her again. <break time="0.8s" /> Some days later. <break time="0.8s" /> She told him. <break time="0.8s" /> In a voice that was hardly more than a whisper. <break time="0.8s" /> That the thing he had waited for had already come. <break time="0.8s" /> It has come, he cried, bewildered. <break time="0.8s" /> And she replied. <break time="0.8s" /> That it had indeed come and gone. <break time="0.8s" /> That it lay behind him now. <break time="0.8s" /> And that he had simply failed. <break time="0.8s" /> To recognize it. <break time="0.8s" /> I would have liked. <break time="0.8s" /> To live for you still. <break time="0.8s" /> She said at last. <break time="0.8s" /> With great tenderness. <break time="0.8s" /> But I cannot. <break time="0.8s" /> And not long after that last meeting. <break time="0.8s" /> May Bartram died. <break time="0.8s" /> Marcher was left. <break time="0.8s" /> With the bewildering knowledge. <break time="0.8s" /> That his fate had somehow already been decided. <break time="0.8s" /> And with the bitter fact. <break time="0.8s" /> That the only person who could explain it. <break time="0.8s" /> Was gone forever.
